description: This file defines a template class 'ScopedStorage' within the 'Thunder::Core' namespace, which manages a fixed-size buffer of bytes. It includes licensing information, include guards, and dependencies on 'Portability.h' and 'Proxy.h'.

classes.name: ScopedStorage
classes.description: A template class that provides a fixed-size buffer with methods to access the buffer and its size, disallowing copy and move semantics.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the beginning of the internal buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer, equal to the template parameter BLOCKSIZE.
